name: Price-data policy and licensed price source
requirement: A written policy on where operator prices come from, plus at least one source that actually publishes an opening and a closing number per market.
threshold: 1 licensed feed; opening and closing timestamps on >= 14 markets for >= 1 week
observed: 0 sources; 0 markets with an external price

name: Opponent-aware ratings

threshold: >= 136 completed games in the log; holdout season held out
observed: reconstructed table only (no game log); rating published explicitly unadjusted

name: Dated, attributed availability register
requirement: Depth order from an official source with a date and a URL per row, for all 32 clubs.
threshold: 32 clubs with a dated depth row; 0 inferred tiers
observed: 1 club route probed (404 on nfl.com, club-hosted link found); 0 depth rows published

name: Designation-to-outcome join
requirement: Practice/game designations joined to the official inactives for the same game.
threshold: >= 2 seasons of weekly reports joined to inactives

name: Designation reliability scored
requirement: Play rate per designation with a confidence interval, before the label is used.
threshold: >= 200 designation/outcome pairs with a Wilson interval per designation
observed: 14 published resolutions, 11 definite; interval too wide to use as a feature

name: Chronological train / validation / holdout split
requirement: Seasons split by time, never at random, with a final holdout never peeked at.
threshold: 3 disjoint windows declared before the first fit
observed: windows declared, not yet populated (needs G1 at full length)

name: Prospective sample
requirement: Results recorded after the forecast, never before.

name: Proper-score ranking
requirement: Leaderboard ordered by a proper score against a stated benchmark, with uncertainty.
threshold: Brier/log score vs benchmark, game-clustered lower bound, multiplicity adjustment

name: Joint-evidence gate for combos
requirement: A parlay or prop combo may be ranked only with a validated joint probability and the operator's void/push rules.
threshold: joint sample for each combo shape + documented void/push rules
observed: 0 combos; no joint sample and no operator rules

name: Control baseline
requirement: Every leaderboard run carries random-pick and favourite-only controls.

name: Drift alarm on every scraper
requirement: Each parser pinned to expected row counts and required fields; missing field fails the build.
threshold: 1 alarm per parser, wired into CI
